Removes dandruff while cleansing and healing scalp conditions. - Ammonium Glycyrrhizate: Reduces inflammation, itchness, redness and dandruff. - Decyl Glocoside: Mild surfactant which is often used in baby products. Maintains skin balance without dryness. - Hydrolyzed Yeast Protein: Locks in moisture and keeps the skin moist and smooth for a long time, not oily. Controls sebum and oil. - Sailcylic Acid: Alleviates flake and dandruff. Recommended for those who have sensitive scalp, are experiencing hair loss and are struggling with scalp trouble such as itching, dandruff, flare up, redness and flaking.
